research.qualityRationale: Bounded read-only API operations with token healthcheck and literal request fixtures.

adaptations: Accepts empty input and validates the API token with GET /user.
Provider is required and bound as the documented path segment /user/organizations/{provider}; cursor and limit are optional query values.
Provider and organization identifiers are encoded by the declarative runtime.
Optional cursor and limit query values are passed only when supplied.
